entries.0d804650617c9d02: It manufactures and sells prefabricated houses and steel structures, leases temporary buildings, and undertakes general construction and solar power system contracts. Consolidated subsidiary Kotobuki Tekko Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing heavy steel frames. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥4,357 million.
entries.2eae86b48ab08214: Manufacturing and logistics companies that use packaging and pallet lumber
entries.332ef21e29b46e5b: It operates a power generation business using natural energy and other sources, running 15 solar power plants in three prefectures, with a total generation capacity of approximately 13 megawatts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥456 million.
entries.5fe4778322cfcaa4: Using pine (radiata pine) imported from New Zealand and domestic sugi (Japanese cedar) as raw materials, it saws lumber at its factory in Fukuyama City, Hiroshima Prefecture, and manufactures and sells packaging lumber, pallet lumber, drum lumber, civil engineering and construction temporary lumber, and wood chips, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥7,442 million.
entries.9cd457c338102e23: It operates one golf club, Nakasu Golf Club, in Shunan City, Yamaguchi Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥382 million.
entries.aa1e6906456c65ac: Construction companies that use civil engineering and construction temporary lumber
entries.b089de0f34d8b868: A company that mills imported pine and domestic cedar to make and sell packing materials and other lumber, and also operates prefabricated houses, steel structures, solar power sales and golf courses.
